server.py:1343 public_journey correctly 404s when share_public is false — prevents accidental leakage; verified by pytest.
FinanceModule.tsx recomputes margin/net client-side too but relies on backend for the source of truth — good.
CompletionModal.tsx uses expo-image + expo-image-picker + expo-haptics + react-native-confetti-cannon — all non-deprecated. No expo-av or expo-barcode-scanner detected in the new code.
